lines.author: Máté Molnár
lines.summary: File notes: reject lockfile paths, grade file notes as claims
lines.text: Only `validate` and the `case.json` expects (why, parts, groups, size, source kinds, mechanical paths, together, apart) change the exit code. The grader is one read-only call per case. It gets the review, the diff of every group, the frozen sources, and the `Must`, `Good`, and `Must not` lists from `expected.md`. It answers yes or no per item with a quote, and marks each document `lookFor` bullet, group `attention` note, focus caption, line note, and file note the review wrote as true or false at head. The case line shows `must 3/4  good 1/2  mustNot 0/3  bullets 2/2 true`. A false bullet is the costly error: the review told the reader something that is not so.

lines.author: Máté Molnár
lines.summary: Eval: one rubric grader per case, read from expected.md
lines.text: The grader does not judge grouping or prose quality. Grouping is checked by `together` and `apart`. Prose is linted: em dashes, sentences over 25 words, summaries with more sentences than the skill allows, and summaries that read as a path list. Lints print on the case line and in the report and do not fail the case.

lines.author: Máté Molnár
lines.summary: Eval: carry the #123 fixes over to the Muse harness
lines.text: - Run one eval process at a time. Parallel runs share one `node_modules` and race `pnpm` and the shared esbuild store.

lines.author: Máté Molnár
lines.summary: Eval: one rubric grader per case, read from expected.md
lines.text: - A failed producer retries once when it wrote no `review.json`. Validate and size failures do not retry. The grader retries only when the model returned text that is not the expected JSON, so a stall does not spend another full timeout.

lines.author: Máté Molnár
lines.summary: Eval: carry the #123 fixes over to the Muse harness
lines.text: - Each run writes `eval/runs/<stamp>/summary.json`. Read the failed case's `result.json` there for the full error. Producer failures also print to stderr as soon as the producer returns, before the graders finish.
